Package hadur2.core.duel

Class MoveDesign

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.duel.MoveDesign
final class MoveDesign extends Object
Duel-side switches for movement experiments; the move package never reads them.

    • GUN_SPLIT

      static final boolean GUN_SPLIT
      MOVE-15: movement by the enemy's gun (meant to be built with HEAT_WAVE). Once enough of the enemy's hits on us are of the learned class, the surf takes the protean pick at the hot setting on the held gun-heat wave; until then it takes the gun-heat wave afresh each tick (the stop-and-start), which does well against simple guns. When true it decides the hold and the protean switch; HEAT_HOLD and PROTEAN are then not read.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • REPLICATOR

      static final boolean REPLICATOR
      MOVE-16: the danger views' weights evolve by the replicator equation. Each enemy bullet that hits us multiplies a view's weight by how well it predicted the bullet's angle relative to the weighted average, with every view's share kept at 2% or more; off, the weights are fixed.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • GUN_GATE

      static final boolean GUN_GATE
      MOVE-17: the gun-heat wave (meant to be built with HEAT_WAVE and HEAT_HOLD false) is offered only while the enemy's gun is not a learning one by MOVE-15's count, so the stop-and-start is dropped against learning guns. Once the gun is called learning the surf is as with the gun-heat wave off. GUN_SPLIT, if on, wins: the gate is then not read.
      See Also:
